content.short: Instantly turn any Tweet into an NFT.
content.description:
Tweet2NFT enables you to instantly turn any tweet into a NFT with minimal difficulty.

Simply reply to any tweet with "@Tweet2NFT mint this". The NFTs are exclusively minted to the Cardano Blockchain.
